evidence.title: Real-time Testing of Satellite Attitude Control With a Reaction Wheel Hardware-In-the-Loop Platform
evidence.abstract: We propose the Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) test of an adaptive satellite attitude control system with reaction wheel health estimation capabilities. Previous simulations and Software-in-the-Loop testing have prompted further experiments to explore the validity of the controller with real momentum exchange devices in the loop. This work is a step toward a comprehensive testing framework for validation of spacecraft attitude control algorithms. The proposed HIL testbed includes brushless DC motors and drivers that communicate using a CAN bus, an embedded computer that executes control and adaptation laws, and a satellite simulator that produces simulated sensor data, estimated attitude states, and responds to actions of the external actuators. We propose methods to artificially induce failures on the reaction wheels, and present related issues and lessons learned.

evidence.title: An exact Ramsey number of large bipartite graphs versus odd wheel
evidence.abstract: The Ramsey number for the pair of graphs $\mathbb{K}_{1,n}$ (star) versus $W_{m}$ (wheel) has been extensively studied. In contrast, the Ramsey number of $\mathbb{K}_{2,n}$ versus the wheel is not yet explored due to the bit more structural complexity of $\mathbb{K}_{2,n}$ compared to the star. In this article, we have established an exact value of $\mathbb{K}_{2,n}$ versus $W_{m}$ for large $n$ and $m$. In particular, we have proved \begin{equation*} R(\mathbb{K}_{2,n}, W_{m})=3n+4, \end{equation*} whenever $n$ and $m$ are sufficiently large integers satisfying $n\geq4m$ and $m$ is an odd integer. This proves the $W_{m}$-goodness of $\mathbb{K}_{2,n}$. Our proof combines probabilistic methods with an analysis of structural dependencies. As part of the argument, we resolve a structural rigidity question concerning highly dependent neighbourhoods (Lemma 3.12).

evidence.title: Three-dimensional phase-field simulations of directional solidification
evidence.abstract: The phase-field method has become in recent years the method of choice for simulating microstructural pattern formation during solidification. One of its main advantages is that time-dependent three-dimensional simulations become feasible. This makes it possible to address long-standing questions of pattern stability. Here, we investigate the stability of hexagonal cells and eutectic lamellae. For cells, it is shown that the geometry of the relevant instability modes is determined by the symmetry of the steady-state pattern, and that the stability limits strongly depend on the strength of the crystalline anisotropy, as was previously found in two dimensions. For eutectics, preliminary investigations of lamella breakup instabilities are presented. The latter are carried out with a newly developed phase-field model of two-phase solidification which offers superior convergence properties.

evidence.title: APLIKASI PERANGKAT LUNAK SISTEM AKUISISI KECEPATAN REACTION WHEEL (SOFTWARE APPLICATION OF REACTION WHEEL SPEED ACQUISITION SYSTEM)/
evidence.abstract: ABSTRACTTransfer of technology activity through reverse engineering is an effort done by developing country in order to decrease technology gap, including in satellite technology, from developed country. To perform measurement anddata acquisition in order to extract design information of a satellite component are the first step in reverse engineering process. This paper reports the result of research on the development of data acquisition software for satellite actuator called reaction wheel speed. In satellite development phase, the wheel speed acquisition system is also possible to be utilized as a testing tool for componente level verification. The wheel speed data obtained from the experiment was represented in graphic of transient response. Based on the data analysis, the developed data acquisition system was possible to be utilized to measure dynamic characteristic of the reaction wheel unit in order to extract its design information. Meanwhile, the analysis done has represented basic part of component level verification test. This fact showed that the developed acquisition system was also possible to be used as testing tool in satellite development phase. ABSTRAKKegiatan alih teknologi melalui reverse engineering merupakan upaya yang dilakukan oleh negara berkembang dalam rangka memperkecil jarak ketimpangan dari negara maju dalam hal teknologi, termasuk teknologi satelit. Melakukan pengukuran dan akuisisi data dalam rangka mengurai informasi desain suatu komponen satelit adalah tahap pertama proses reverse engineering. Makalah ini melaporkan hasil penelitian mengenai pengembangan perangkat lunak sistem akuisisi data kecepatan wheel dari sebuah aktuator satelit yang disebut reaction wheel unit. Dalam aspek fase pengembangan satelit, sistem akuisisi data ini dapat digunakan sebagai perangkat pengujian untuk verifikasi di tingkat komponen. evidence.title: Modeling the Stiction Effect in Automatic Compressor Valves
evidence.abstract: The so-called stiction effect (or stiction force) is one of the sources of thermodynamic losses in compressor suction and discharge systems. The losses associated with the stiction effect are caused by a deformation of the lubricating oil film between the valve and the seat. This generates a delay in the valve opening, since larger pressure differencesbetween the cylinder and the discharge and/or suction chambers are needed to compensate for those effects. This paper advances a theoretical model for solving the dynamic behavior of a ring-shaped lubricant oil film between a discharge valve and the seat. The valve is allowed to move under the action of an external force due to the timedependent pressure difference between the cylinder and the discharge chamber. The main contributions of the model are the consideration of a finite amount of oil between the valve and the seat and mathematical relationships for calculating the initial condition for the oil film thickness. The model results are compared with those obtained with the Khalifa and Liu (1998) method. At conditions typical of discharge systems of domestic refrigeration compressors, viscous effects are the dominant component in the oil stiction force under dynamic conditions

In satellite development phase, the wheel speed acquisition system is also possible to be utilized as a testing tool for componente level verification. The wheel speed data obtained from the experiment was represented in graphic of transient response. Based on the data analysis, the developed data acquisition system was possible to be utilized to measure dynamic characteristic of the reaction wheel unit in order to extract its design information. Meanwhile, the analysis done has represented basic part of component level verification test. This fact showed that the developed acquisition system was also possible to be used as testing tool in satellite development phase. ABSTRAKKegiatan alih teknologi melalui reverse engineering merupakan upaya yang dilakukan oleh negara berkembang dalam rangka memperkecil jarak ketimpangan dari negara maju dalam hal teknologi, termasuk teknologi satelit. Melakukan pengukuran dan akuisisi data dalam rangka mengurai informasi desain suatu komponen satelit adalah tahap pertama proses reverse engineering. Makalah ini melaporkan hasil penelitian mengenai pengembangan perangkat lunak sistem akuisisi data kecepatan wheel dari sebuah aktuator satelit yang disebut reaction wheel unit. Dalam aspek fase pengembangan satelit, sistem akuisisi data ini dapat digunakan sebagai perangkat pengujian untuk verifikasi di tingkat komponen. Data kecepatan wheel, yang diperoleh dari eksperimen yang dilakukan, ditampilkan dengan grafik respon transien. Berdasarkan analisis atas data tersebut, sistem akusisi data yang dikembangkan menjanjikan untuk digunakan dalam rangka pengukuran karakteristik dinamik reaction wheel sebagai upaya mengurai informasi desainnya. Selain itu, analisis yang telah dilakukan merepresentasikan bagian dasar dari tahap verifikasi di tingkat komponen. Hal ini menunjukkan bahwa sistem akusisi data ini menjanjikan untuk digunakan sebag

cemetery_warnings.lesson:
FROZEN THEOREM CE-018: A novelty claim survives only when the candidate's CAPABILITY (what it can DO) is demonstrably absent from the prior art landscape — not when the candidate's KEYWORDS (what words it uses) are absent. The correct procedure: (1) decompose the candidate into its functional capabilities (e.g., 'intrapprocedural clot sensing' not 'retrieved-clot physical signature measurement'); (2) search the prior art landscape for each capability using the prior art's own vocabulary (assignee names, CPC classes, commercial product names, inventor terminology); (3) build a capability collision matrix mapping each capability to prior art coverage; (4) only if at least one capability is genuinely UNOCCUPIED (confirmed by both patent search AND commercial frontier analysis) can a novelty claim be recorded. Semantic re-skins (CE-012 violation) include: 'retrieved-clot' vs 'in-situ clot'; 'physical signature' vs 'composition'; 'integrated sensor' vs 'catheter-mounted sensor.' These distinctions prove nothing. The test is capability, not vocabulary.

SHARPENED (per CEO Round 62 audit): Capability novelty must be evaluated at the FUNCTIONAL END-TO-END level: input → inference → decision → physical effect → measurable outcome. Otherwise the machine can still find a 'novel' intermediate layer (e.g., a new sensor modality, a new feature, a new algorithm) that is already covered by an existing end-to-end system. The correct end-to-end test: (5) decompose the candidate into the complete causal loop — what is observed → what is inferred → what is predicted → what physical action becomes possible → what measurable outcome changes; (6) map each step of this loop to the prior art's end-to-end systems (not just individual capabilities); (7) only if the candidate's complete causal loop is demonstrably absent from the prior art's end-to-end systems can a novelty claim be recorded. A 'novel' intermediate layer that plugs into an existing end-to-end system is NOT novel — it is a substitution, not an invention. The unit of novelty is the complete causal loop, not the sensor, feature, algorithm, or capability.

candidates.intervention: Replace standard aerospace grease with a specialized low-temperature polyalphaolefin (PAO) grease formulated with high-viscosity-index additives to maintain fluidity down to -65°C, reducing the coefficient of static friction.
candidates.predicted_effect: Reduction of static friction coefficient by 40% at -50°C, eliminating stall events during shadow periods while maintaining lubricant life within nominal thermal cycles.
candidates.testable_prediction: Bench test the modified bearing at -50°C in a thermal vacuum chamber; if stiction torque exceeds the minimum drive torque of the reaction wheel, the hypothesis is falsified.

A combination qualifies only if it produces a demonstrably new technical effect that survives prior art and non-obviousness attack. Orthogonality to one architecture does not imply independence from the underlying physiology. Before claiming a signal is 'new information,' test whether it is causally downstream of an already-measured variable. If A → B and A is measured, then B is a proxy for A, not new information — even if B is measured by a different sensor.

warnings.lesson: FROZEN THEOREM CE-016 (sharpened per CEO Round 58): A proposed latent quantity survives only when (1) identifiability is demonstrated under an EXPLICIT observation/dynamics model with full rank/observability analysis (not naive unknown-count), AND (2) identifiability REMAINS under plausible model uncertainty (each ideal assumption relaxed toward realistic physics and re-tested). A single favorable rank calculation under a convenient model is INSUFFICIENT. A single unfavorable perturbation model is ALSO INSUFFICIENT to claim universal non-identifiability — it only kills the specific estimator tested under that specific perturbation model. The correct procedure: (a) define state, observables, inputs, noise, known/unknown params; (b) build measurement equations; (c) test rank of Jacobian wrt unknown params; (d) perform adversarial model-uncertainty test: relax each assumption toward realistic physics and re-test identifiability under the combined relaxed model; (e) only if BOTH the ideal-model rank AND the adversarial-model rank hold (or constructively fail) can a universal claim (measurable OR non-measurable) be recorded.

warnings.lesson: FROZEN THEOREM CE-017: A discovery engine earns trust when it attacks its own successful proof harder than its unsuccessful ideas. Structural identifiability under a convenient model is not enough. A candidate must survive adversarial model uncertainty AND practical operation (safety, timing, decision value, first-pass vs post-hoc). The burden is bidirectional: (a) the proposer must demonstrate identifiability survives realistic model relaxation; (b) the killer must demonstrate non-identifiability holds under EVERY plausible estimator and measurement protocol, not just the one they chose to attack. When in doubt, the implementation is killed; the scientific question stays open until either (a) a survivor is found or (b) an explicit non-identifiability counterexample is constructed (two physically distinct latent states producing indistinguishable observations under ALL measurement protocols).

warnings.territory: Cross-cutting (extracted from Round 62 capability collision failure; applies to ALL novelty claims)
warnings.mechanism: Capability collision test — keyword collision search is insufficient to establish novelty
warnings.lesson:
FROZEN THEOREM CE-018: A novelty claim survives only when the candidate's CAPABILITY (what it can DO) is demonstrably absent from the prior art landscape — not when the candidate's KEYWORDS (what words it uses) are absent. The correct procedure: (1) decompose the candidate into its functional capabilities (e.g., 'intrapprocedural clot sensing' not 'retrieved-clot physical signature measurement'); (2) search the prior art landscape for each capability using the prior art's own vocabulary (assignee names, CPC classes, commercial product names, inventor terminology); (3) build a capability collision matrix mapping each capability to prior art coverage; (4) only if at least one capability is genuinely UNOCCUPIED (confirmed by both patent search AND commercial frontier analysis) can a novelty claim be recorded. Semantic re-skins (CE-012 violation) include: 'retrieved-clot' vs 'in-situ clot'; 'physical signature' vs 'composition'; 'integrated sensor' vs 'catheter-mounted sensor.' These distinctions prove nothing. The test is capability, not vocabulary.

SHARPENED (per CEO Round 62 audit): Capability novelty must be evaluated at the FUNCTIONAL END-TO-END level: input → inference → decision → physical effect → measurable outcome. Otherwise the machine can still find a 'novel' intermediate layer (e.g., a new sensor modality, a new feature, a new algorithm) that is already covered by an existing end-to-end system. The correct end-to-end test: (5) decompose the candidate into the complete causal loop — what is observed → what is inferred → what is predicted → what physical action becomes possible → what measurable outcome changes; (6) map each step of this loop to the prior art's end-to-end systems (not just individual capabilities); (7) only if the candidate's complete causal loop is demonstrably absent from the prior art's end-to-end systems can a novelty claim be recorded. A 'novel' intermediate layer that plugs into an existing end-to-end system is NOT novel — it is a substitution, not an invention. The unit of novelty is the complete causal loop, not the sensor, feature, algorithm, or capability.

informational.mechanism: RES-4 narrow: adaptive transverse/sigmoid sinus stent for CSF absorption regulation via AG pressure gradient control
informational.lesson: MODEL-BOUNDED NEGATIVE RESULT: Before inventing variable geometry, calculate absolute pressure-control authority at the actual operating point. Relative r^4 sensitivity is meaningless if the absolute pressure drop is tiny. Under realistic post-stenting conditions (D=5-10mm, Q=200-500 mL/min), adaptive diameter control of a venous sinus produces <0.2 mmHg change in AG gradient — 5x below the 1 mmHg pre-registered threshold. Control authority exists only in the stenotic+high-flow regime (D≤4mm, Q≥1200 mL/min), which is incompatible with a stented patient whose stent has normalized diameter to 7-10mm. The network model (1323 configs) confirms: flow redistribution through contralateral sinus does NOT rescue control authority (dominance has no effect). NOT a universal vascular invariant — based on Poiseuille model with specific assumptions about geometry, flow, and topology.

informational.mechanism: Minimum Sufficient Validation Evidence Derivation (MSVED) — 4-link chain: ML change → clinical pathway → risk envelope → minimum sufficient evidence → sufficiency proof
informational.lesson: FROZEN THEOREM CE-019: A clinical-pathway-aware evidence selector must demonstrate that the clinical-pathway bridge produces a MATERIALLY DIFFERENT and BETTER evidence set than information-maximizing selection (BOED). If the pathway-aware selector uses MORE tests while achieving WORSE assurance, the clinical-pathway bridge adds complexity without value. The minimum-evidence claim must be validated by showing tests_required < BOED, not just tests_required < conventional. The killer experiment must compare against the STRONGEST available baseline (BOED), not just conventional full-validation.

informational.mechanism: Automated Sufficiency Proof Generator (CC-04 / MSES theorem) — formal proof that a specific evidence set E is sufficient to establish modification-specific clinical risk envelope R(Δ)
informational.lesson: FROZEN THEOREM CE-020: A sufficiency proof that is merely an integration of known statistical methods (NI testing + coverage + multiple-testing correction + sensitivity analysis) is NOT a novel mathematical result. Under §103, combining known methods to solve a problem the market explicitly asks for is likely obvious (KSR v. Teleflex). The frontier is a NEW MATHEMATICAL BOUND — e.g., a tight bound on minimum evidence set size that is better than what existing methods give individually, or a proof technique that connects clinical pathway coverage to statistical sufficiency in a way that is not derivable from existing theory. Additionally: killer tests for sufficiency proofs must include a TRUE POSITIVE case (sufficient evidence for a SAFE modification that the system correctly accepts), not just a true negative (insufficient evidence that the system correctly rejects).

informational.mechanism: Non-Inferiority Statistical Engine (CC-08) — automated paired NI comparison with pre-registered margins for ML model modifications
informational.lesson: FROZEN THEOREM CE-021: Automating a standard statistical test (NI testing) for a regulatory context that explicitly requires it (PCCP) is NOT an invention. Under KSR, combining known methods to solve a problem the market explicitly asks for is obvious. The coder correctly identified this in the R254 ranking ("NI testing is standard, high collision risk") but incorrectly chose to proceed. The CEO corrected: high collision risk is a RED FLAG, not a reason to proceed. Kill immediately if the smallest surviving mechanism is standard statistics + ML context + automated reporting.

informational.mechanism: SGET (Strain-Gated Electrochemical Transduction) — A=strain pulse changes B=electrochemical sensor from 2D surface to 3D depth profiling. First synergy-2 candidate.
informational.lesson: FROZEN THEOREM CE-022: Synergy ≠ novelty and synergy ≠ commercial moat. A functional interaction (A changes B) is NECESSARY but NOT SUFFICIENT for invention. The interaction itself — the causal law, the emergent effect, and functional equivalents across domains — must survive prior art independently. Additionally: synergy claims without quantitative comparison against the STRONGEST baseline are stories, not evidence. The unexpected-effect proof requires: (1) pre-registered quantitative prediction, (2) strongest baseline identified, (3) killer experiment vs that baseline, (4) result not predictable from A and B independently. The new standard: A changes B → unexpected effect → interaction survives prior art → reproducible advantage → cannot be cheaply reproduced → buyer value.

informational.mechanism: SC-05 Biofilm-Resistant Living-Surface Venous Interface — continuously renewing anti-biofilm surface with active surface-energy control at CSF-blood interface
informational.lesson: FROZEN THEOREM CE-023: A candidate that survives the 14-gate protocol at the CONCEPT level can be killed at the ELEMENT-DECOMPOSITION level. The 14 gates assessed M4 against the broad concept (continuously renewing anti-biofilm surface) and found M4=NOT FOUND. But deep collision revealed that each element (continuous renewal, dynamic topography, surface-energy modulation) is individually occupied by prior art. The combination is an aggregation of known anti-fouling approaches. The lesson: M4 must be assessed at the ELEMENT level, not the concept level. And M4=NOT FOUND means the search has not found comparable performance yet — not that it does not exist.

warnings.lesson: FROZEN THEOREM (sharpened per CEO Round 56o): 'Existing information + existing transformation + existing control, merely recombined, is insufficient. A combination qualifies only if it produces a demonstrably new technical effect that survives prior art and non-obviousness attack. A world-class invention needs a genuinely new technical information source, transformation, or control capability. Do not build an AI layer on top of an already-claimed sensing/control architecture.' NOTE: This theorem does NOT create a universal 'new sensor required' rule. A novel combination of existing measurements CAN qualify if it produces a new, technically non-obvious effect. warnings.lesson: A signal can be GENUINELY ORTHOGONAL to a specific measurement architecture (Hakim measures pressure, not HRV) and still be a DOWNSTREAM CONSEQUENCE of the same physiological variable (ICP → sympathetic → HRV). Orthogonality to one architecture does not imply independence from the underlying physiology. Before claiming a signal is 'new information,' test whether it is causally downstream of an already-measured variable. If A → B and A is measured, then B is a proxy for A, not new information — even if B is measured by a different sensor.

warnings.lesson: FROZEN THEOREM CE-016 (sharpened per CEO Round 58): A proposed latent quantity survives only when (1) identifiability is demonstrated under an EXPLICIT observation/dynamics model with full rank/observability analysis (not naive unknown-count), AND (2) identifiability REMAINS under plausible model uncertainty (each ideal assumption relaxed toward realistic physics and re-tested). A single favorable rank calculation under a convenient model is INSUFFICIENT. A single unfavorable perturbation model is ALSO INSUFFICIENT to claim universal non-identifiability — it only kills the specific estimator tested under that specific perturbation model. The correct procedure: (a) define state, observables, inputs, noise, known/unknown params; (b) build measurement equations; (c) test rank of Jacobian wrt unknown params; (d) perform adversarial model-uncertainty test: relax each assumption toward realistic physics and re-test identifiability under the combined relaxed model; (e) only if BOTH the ideal-model rank AND the adversarial-model rank hold (or constructively fail) can a universal claim (measurable OR non-measurable) be recorded.
warnings.action_required: Explicit justification required to proceed despite this constraint

warnings.territory: Cross-cutting (extracted from Stroke Round 58; applies to all latent-variable inventions)
warnings.mechanism: Structural identifiability under a convenient model is not enough — adversarial model-uncertainty and practical-operation survival are mandatory
warnings.lesson: FROZEN THEOREM CE-017: A discovery engine earns trust when it attacks its own successful proof harder than its unsuccessful ideas. Structural identifiability under a convenient model is not enough. A candidate must survive adversarial model uncertainty AND practical operation (safety, timing, decision value, first-pass vs post-hoc). The burden is bidirectional: (a) the proposer must demonstrate identifiability survives realistic model relaxation; (b) the killer must demonstrate non-identifiability holds under EVERY plausible estimator and measurement protocol, not just the one they chose to attack. When in doubt, the implementation is killed; the scientific question stays open until either (a) a survivor is found or (b) an explicit non-identifiability counterexample is constructed (two physically distinct latent states producing indistinguishable observations under ALL measurement protocols).
warnings.action_required: Explicit justification required to proceed despite this constraint

warnings.territory: Cross-cutting (extracted from Round 62 capability collision failure; applies to ALL novelty claims)
warnings.mechanism: Capability collision test — keyword collision search is insufficient to establish novelty
warnings.lesson:
FROZEN THEOREM CE-018: A novelty claim survives only when the candidate's CAPABILITY (what it can DO) is demonstrably absent from the prior art landscape — not when the candidate's KEYWORDS (what words it uses) are absent. The correct procedure: (1) decompose the candidate into its functional capabilities (e.g., 'intrapprocedural clot sensing' not 'retrieved-clot physical signature measurement'); (2) search the prior art landscape for each capability using the prior art's own vocabulary (assignee names, CPC classes, commercial product names, inventor terminology); (3) build a capability collision matrix mapping each capability to prior art coverage; (4) only if at least one capability is genuinely UNOCCUPIED (confirmed by both patent search AND commercial frontier analysis) can a novelty claim be recorded. Semantic re-skins (CE-012 violation) include: 'retrieved-clot' vs 'in-situ clot'; 'physical signature' vs 'composition'; 'integrated sensor' vs 'catheter-mounted sensor.' These distinctions prove nothing. The test is capability, not vocabulary.

SHARPENED (per CEO Round 62 audit): Capability novelty must be evaluated at the FUNCTIONAL END-TO-END level: input → inference → decision → physical effect → measurable outcome. Otherwise the machine can still find a 'novel' intermediate layer (e.g., a new sensor modality, a new feature, a new algorithm) that is already covered by an existing end-to-end system. The correct end-to-end test: (5) decompose the candidate into the complete causal loop — what is observed → what is inferred → what is predicted → what physical action becomes possible → what measurable outcome changes; (6) map each step of this loop to the prior art's end-to-end systems (not just individual capabilities); (7) only if the candidate's complete causal loop is demonstrably absent from the prior art's end-to-end systems can a novelty claim be recorded. A 'novel' intermediate layer that plugs into an existing end-to-end system is NOT novel — it is a substitution, not an invention. The unit of novelty is the complete causal loop, not the sensor, feature, algorithm, or capability.

informational.lesson: Retrograde flush for eShunt pushes debris toward brain. The eShunt venous drainage direction makes retrograde more dangerous than VP shunts (peritoneal). However, the clinical hazard is ANALOGICAL (SAH blood causes inflammation), not directly proven for shunt debris. MODEL_DERIVED + ANALOGICAL_EVIDENCE — not PROVEN_UNSAFE.

informational.mechanism: RES-4 narrow: adaptive transverse/sigmoid sinus stent for CSF absorption regulation via AG pressure gradient control
informational.lesson: MODEL-BOUNDED NEGATIVE RESULT: Before inventing variable geometry, calculate absolute pressure-control authority at the actual operating point. Relative r^4 sensitivity is meaningless if the absolute pressure drop is tiny. Under realistic post-stenting conditions (D=5-10mm, Q=200-500 mL/min), adaptive diameter control of a venous sinus produces <0.2 mmHg change in AG gradient — 5x below the 1 mmHg pre-registered threshold. Control authority exists only in the stenotic+high-flow regime (D≤4mm, Q≥1200 mL/min), which is incompatible with a stented patient whose stent has normalized diameter to 7-10mm. The network model (1323 configs) confirms: flow redistribution through contralateral sinus does NOT rescue control authority (dominance has no effect). NOT a universal vascular invariant — based on Poiseuille model with specific assumptions about geometry, flow, and topology.

informational.mechanism: Minimum Sufficient Validation Evidence Derivation (MSVED) — 4-link chain: ML change → clinical pathway → risk envelope → minimum sufficient evidence → sufficiency proof
informational.lesson: FROZEN THEOREM CE-019: A clinical-pathway-aware evidence selector must demonstrate that the clinical-pathway bridge produces a MATERIALLY DIFFERENT and BETTER evidence set than information-maximizing selection (BOED). If the pathway-aware selector uses MORE tests while achieving WORSE assurance, the clinical-pathway bridge adds complexity without value. The minimum-evidence claim must be validated by showing tests_required < BOED, not just tests_required < conventional. The killer experiment must compare against the STRONGEST available baseline (BOED), not just conventional full-validation.

informational.mechanism: Automated Sufficiency Proof Generator (CC-04 / MSES theorem) — formal proof that a specific evidence set E is sufficient to establish modification-specific clinical risk envelope R(Δ)
informational.lesson: FROZEN THEOREM CE-020: A sufficiency proof that is merely an integration of known statistical methods (NI testing + coverage + multiple-testing correction + sensitivity analysis) is NOT a novel mathematical result. Under §103, combining known methods to solve a problem the market explicitly asks for is likely obvious (KSR v. Teleflex). The frontier is a NEW MATHEMATICAL BOUND — e.g., a tight bound on minimum evidence set size that is better than what existing methods give individually, or a proof technique that connects clinical pathway coverage to statistical sufficiency in a way that is not derivable from existing theory. Additionally: killer tests for sufficiency proofs must include a TRUE POSITIVE case (sufficient evidence for a SAFE modification that the system correctly accepts), not just a true negative (insufficient evidence that the system correctly rejects).

informational.mechanism: Non-Inferiority Statistical Engine (CC-08) — automated paired NI comparison with pre-registered margins for ML model modifications
informational.lesson: FROZEN THEOREM CE-021: Automating a standard statistical test (NI testing) for a regulatory context that explicitly requires it (PCCP) is NOT an invention. Under KSR, combining known methods to solve a problem the market explicitly asks for is obvious. The coder correctly identified this in the R254 ranking ("NI testing is standard, high collision risk") but incorrectly chose to proceed. The CEO corrected: high collision risk is a RED FLAG, not a reason to proceed. Kill immediately if the smallest surviving mechanism is standard statistics + ML context + automated reporting.

informational.mechanism: SGET (Strain-Gated Electrochemical Transduction) — A=strain pulse changes B=electrochemical sensor from 2D surface to 3D depth profiling. First synergy-2 candidate.
informational.lesson: FROZEN THEOREM CE-022: Synergy ≠ novelty and synergy ≠ commercial moat. A functional interaction (A changes B) is NECESSARY but NOT SUFFICIENT for invention. The interaction itself — the causal law, the emergent effect, and functional equivalents across domains — must survive prior art independently. Additionally: synergy claims without quantitative comparison against the STRONGEST baseline are stories, not evidence. The unexpected-effect proof requires: (1) pre-registered quantitative prediction, (2) strongest baseline identified, (3) killer experiment vs that baseline, (4) result not predictable from A and B independently. The new standard: A changes B → unexpected effect → interaction survives prior art → reproducible advantage → cannot be cheaply reproduced → buyer value.

informational.mechanism: SC-05 Biofilm-Resistant Living-Surface Venous Interface — continuously renewing anti-biofilm surface with active surface-energy control at CSF-blood interface
informational.lesson: FROZEN THEOREM CE-023: A candidate that survives the 14-gate protocol at the CONCEPT level can be killed at the ELEMENT-DECOMPOSITION level. The 14 gates assessed M4 against the broad concept (continuously renewing anti-biofilm surface) and found M4=NOT FOUND. But deep collision revealed that each element (continuous renewal, dynamic topography, surface-energy modulation) is individually occupied by prior art. The combination is an aggregation of known anti-fouling approaches. The lesson: M4 must be assessed at the ELEMENT level, not the concept level. And M4=NOT FOUND means the search has not found comparable performance yet — not that it does not exist.

custody_records.raw_content: We propose the Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) test of an adaptive satellite attitude control system with reaction wheel health estimation capabilities. Previous simulations and Software-in-the-Loop testing have prompted further experiments to explore the validity of the controller with real momentum exchange devices in the loop. This work is a step toward a comprehensive testing framework for validation of spacecraft attitude control algorithms. The proposed HIL testbed includes brushless DC motors and drivers that communicate using a CAN bus, an embedded computer that executes control and adaptation laws, and a satellite simulator that produces simulated sensor data, estimated attitude states, and responds to actions of the external actuators. We propose methods to artificially induce failures on the reaction wheels, and present related issues and lessons learned.

custody_records.raw_content: The Ramsey number for the pair of graphs $\mathbb{K}_{1,n}$ (star) versus $W_{m}$ (wheel) has been extensively studied. In contrast, the Ramsey number of $\mathbb{K}_{2,n}$ versus the wheel is not yet explored due to the bit more structural complexity of $\mathbb{K}_{2,n}$ compared to the star. In this article, we have established an exact value of $\mathbb{K}_{2,n}$ versus $W_{m}$ for large $n$ and $m$. In particular, we have proved \begin{equation*} R(\mathbb{K}_{2,n}, W_{m})=3n+4, \end{equation*} whenever $n$ and $m$ are sufficiently large integers satisfying $n\geq4m$ and $m$ is an odd integer. This proves the $W_{m}$-goodness of $\mathbb{K}_{2,n}$. Our proof combines probabilistic methods with an analysis of structural dependencies. As part of the argument, we resolve a structural rigidity question concerning highly dependent neighbourhoods (Lemma 3.12).

custody_records.raw_content: The phase-field method has become in recent years the method of choice for simulating microstructural pattern formation during solidification. One of its main advantages is that time-dependent three-dimensional simulations become feasible. This makes it possible to address long-standing questions of pattern stability. Here, we investigate the stability of hexagonal cells and eutectic lamellae. For cells, it is shown that the geometry of the relevant instability modes is determined by the symmetry of the steady-state pattern, and that the stability limits strongly depend on the strength of the crystalline anisotropy, as was previously found in two dimensions. For eutectics, preliminary investigations of lamella breakup instabilities are presented. The latter are carried out with a newly developed phase-field model of two-phase solidification which offers superior convergence properties.

To perform measurement anddata acquisition in order to extract design information of a satellite component are the first step in reverse engineering process. This paper reports the result of research on the development of data acquisition software for satellite actuator called reaction wheel speed. In satellite development phase, the wheel speed acquisition system is also possible to be utilized as a testing tool for componente level verification. The wheel speed data obtained from the experiment was represented in graphic of transient response. Based on the data analysis, the developed data acquisition system was possible to be utilized to measure dynamic characteristic of the reaction wheel unit in order to extract its design information. Meanwhile, the analysis done has represented basic part of component level verification test. This fact showed that the developed acquisition system was also possible to be used as testing tool in satellite development phase. Melakukan pengukuran dan akuisisi data dalam rangka mengurai informasi desain suatu komponen satelit adalah tahap pertama proses reverse engineering. Makalah ini melaporkan hasil penelitian mengenai pengembangan perangkat lunak sistem akuisisi data kecepatan wheel dari sebuah aktuator satelit yang disebut reaction wheel unit. custody_records.raw_content: The so-called stiction effect (or stiction force) is one of the sources of thermodynamic losses in compressor suction and discharge systems. The losses associated with the stiction effect are caused by a deformation of the lubricating oil film between the valve and the seat. This generates a delay in the valve opening, since larger pressure differencesbetween the cylinder and the discharge and/or suction chambers are needed to compensate for those effects. This paper advances a theoretical model for solving the dynamic behavior of a ring-shaped lubricant oil film between a discharge valve and the seat. The valve is allowed to move under the action of an external force due to the timedependent pressure difference between the cylinder and the discharge chamber. The main contributions of the model are the consideration of a finite amount of oil between the valve and the seat and mathematical relationships for calculating the initial condition for the oil film thickness. The model results are compared with those obtained with the Khalifa and Liu (1998) method. At conditions typical of discharge systems of domestic refrigeration compressors, viscous effects are the dominant component in the oil stiction force under dynamic conditions

User-submitted engineering problem (session input): "A small satellite reaction wheel intermittently stalls at low temperature, causing attitude drift only in shadow. What mechanism couples the wheel bearing to the thermal event, and what single on-orbit test would settle it?".  ROUTING: doe_osti: routing state SUSPENDED_RELEVANCE — measured relevance instability (R375: same fusion papers relevant 3 -> 0; pooled relevant-rate 0.175 pre-fix; DETERMINISM_GAP flagged in the R394 production audit) — records poison synthesis-feeding retrieval more than they feed it until relevance is semantically adjudicated; reinstatement: the Phase P1 semantic reranker lands (semantic relevance adjudication between query and record, replacing lexical overlap); flip to ACTIVE + a measured relevance re-run + worklog entry. [nasa_ntrs] retrieval status EMPTY — provider outcome recorded, not treated as absence (Art. XXI.3). [doe_osti] retrieval status NOT_QUERIED_SUSPENDED_RELEVANCE (engine routing decision (R399 W3): SUSPENDED_RELEVANCE — not a provider failure and not absence) — provider outcome recorded, not treated as absence (Art. XXI.3). Problem-existence basis: NO SOURCE RETURNED RECORDS — problem existence UNVERIFIED by live evidence (Art. XX); treat as hypothesis.

value.mechanism: Cold-temperature exposure causes baseline grease to exceed its critical solidification temperature, drastically increasing shear modulus and causing static friction (stiction) spikes; this prevents the bearing rollers from rolling, leading to stall when torques are low during shadow phase.

CROSS_DOMAIN_MIN_NONGENERIC_OVERLAP.justification: R377 patent-text ground truth (TOSCANINI/R377_PATENT_TEXT_FETCH.json + R377_PATENT_TEXT_GROUND_TRUTH.json): 12/30 family representatives (40%) were substantively irrelevant cross-domain term collisions (CWDM optical link for a battery-thermal candidate; dental-condition monitoring for rolling stock; bone fracture forceps for rail steel...). A hit sharing NO entity term with the candidate now needs >= 3 NON-generic mechanism terms to be mechanism art: the measured true cross-domain analog (line-pipe steel with hydrogen fracture toughness for a rail-steel candidate) shares 3 non-generic terms and survives; every measured false positive shares <= 2 and is demoted. This RAISES the cross-domain bar (was the same >= 2 as same-domain) — stricter, not weaker (Art. VII).
CROSS_DOMAIN_MIN_NONGENERIC_OVERLAP.uncertainty: term overlap remains a proxy; entity word-sense collisions ('gear': steering vs draft) can still pass — disclosed limitation, not a solved problem

MIN_MECHANISM_OVERLAP.justification: same term-overlap rule family as the pipeline relevance adjudicator and the Q2 instrument (>= 2 shared content terms = domain-specific rather than accidental collision); NOT weakened relative to any prior gate
MIN_MECHANISM_OVERLAP.uncertainty: term overlap is a proxy for mechanism identity

ANTICIPATION_COVERAGE_RATIO.justification: a family ANTICIPATES only when nearly ALL elements of the candidate's FULL distinguishing set (uncapped — the claim elements, not the 6-term query core) appear in the family's claim/abstract text; 0.8 leaves a >= 20% element margin — anything lower would convert partial art into a kill (Art. XXVIII forbids). Measured adversarial case: a domain-only patent reached 0.857 against a capped denominator whose true differentiators (acoustic, multi-modal) had been ranked out
ANTICIPATION_COVERAGE_RATIO.uncertainty: claim coverage measured by term overlap, not a claim chart; recorded per family with evidence tier

MAX_QUERY_TERMS.justification: provider-measured sweet spot for keyword patent queries (longer queries dilute ranking)

ABSTRACT_TIER_MIN_CHARS.justification: below ~80 chars a snippet carries title echoes, not mechanism description; it cannot support an abstract-tier coverage decision

doi:10.48550/arxiv.2508.19164.title: Real-time Testing of Satellite Attitude Control With a Reaction Wheel Hardware-In-the-Loop Platform
doi:10.48550/arxiv.2508.19164.abstract: We propose the Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) test of an adaptive satellite attitude control system with reaction wheel health estimation capabilities. Previous simulations and Software-in-the-Loop testing have prompted further experiments to explore the validity of the controller with real momentum exchange devices in the loop. This work is a step toward a comprehensive testing framework for validation of spacecraft attitude control algorithms. The proposed HIL testbed includes brushless DC motors and drivers that communicate using a CAN bus, an embedded computer that executes control and adaptation laws, and a satellite simulator that produces simulated sensor data, estimated attitude states, and responds to actions of the external actuators. We propose methods to artificially induce failures on the reaction wheels, and present related issues and lessons learned.

doi:10.48550/arxiv.2511.14867.title: An exact Ramsey number of large bipartite graphs versus odd wheel
doi:10.48550/arxiv.2511.14867.abstract: The Ramsey number for the pair of graphs $\mathbb{K}_{1,n}$ (star) versus $W_{m}$ (wheel) has been extensively studied. In contrast, the Ramsey number of $\mathbb{K}_{2,n}$ versus the wheel is not yet explored due to the bit more structural complexity of $\mathbb{K}_{2,n}$ compared to the star. In this article, we have established an exact value of $\mathbb{K}_{2,n}$ versus $W_{m}$ for large $n$ and $m$. In particular, we have proved \begin{equation*} R(\mathbb{K}_{2,n}, W_{m})=3n+4, \end{equation*} whenever $n$ and $m$ are sufficiently large integers satisfying $n\geq4m$ and $m$ is an odd integer. This proves the $W_{m}$-goodness of $\mathbb{K}_{2,n}$. Our proof combines probabilistic methods with an analysis of structural dependencies. As part of the argument, we resolve a structural rigidity question concerning highly dependent neighbourhoods (Lemma 3.12).

doi:10.48550/arxiv.0401250.title: Three-dimensional phase-field simulations of directional solidification
doi:10.48550/arxiv.0401250.abstract: The phase-field method has become in recent years the method of choice for simulating microstructural pattern formation during solidification. One of its main advantages is that time-dependent three-dimensional simulations become feasible. This makes it possible to address long-standing questions of pattern stability. Here, we investigate the stability of hexagonal cells and eutectic lamellae. For cells, it is shown that the geometry of the relevant instability modes is determined by the symmetry of the steady-state pattern, and that the stability limits strongly depend on the strength of the crystalline anisotropy, as was previously found in two dimensions. For eutectics, preliminary investigations of lamella breakup instabilities are presented. The latter are carried out with a newly developed phase-field model of two-phase solidification which offers superior convergence properties.

title:f8b9bfd37e1427ea.title: APLIKASI PERANGKAT LUNAK SISTEM AKUISISI KECEPATAN REACTION WHEEL (SOFTWARE APPLICATION OF REACTION WHEEL SPEED ACQUISITION SYSTEM)/
title:f8b9bfd37e1427ea.abstract: ABSTRACTTransfer of technology activity through reverse engineering is an effort done by developing country in order to decrease technology gap, including in satellite technology, from developed country. To perform measurement anddata acquisition in order to extract design information of a satellite component are the first step in reverse engineering process. This paper reports the result of research on the development of data acquisition software for satellite actuator called reaction wheel speed. In satellite development phase, the wheel speed acquisition system is also possible to be utilized as a testing tool for componente level verification. The wheel speed data obtained from the experiment was represented in graphic of transient response. Based on the data analysis, the developed data acquisition system was possible to be utilized to measure dynamic characteristic of the reaction wheel unit in order to extract its design information. Meanwhile, the analysis done has represented basic part of component level verification test. This fact showed that the developed acquisition system was also possible to be used as testing tool in satellite development phase. ABSTRAKKegiatan alih teknologi melalui reverse engineering merupakan upaya yang dilakukan oleh negara berkembang dalam rangka memperkecil jarak ketimpangan dari negara maju dalam hal teknologi, termasuk teknologi satelit. Melakukan pengukuran dan akuisisi data dalam rangka mengurai informasi desain suatu komponen satelit adalah tahap pertama proses reverse engineering. Makalah ini melaporkan hasil penelitian mengenai pengembangan perangkat lunak sistem akuisisi data kecepatan wheel dari sebuah aktuator satelit yang disebut reaction wheel unit. Dalam aspek fase pengembangan satelit, sistem akuisisi data ini dapat digunakan sebagai perangkat pengujian untuk verifikasi di tingkat komponen. Data kecepatan wheel, yang diperoleh dari eksperimen yang dilakukan, ditampilkan dengan grafik respon transien. title:91bc4ab11064bae5.title: Modeling the Stiction Effect in Automatic Compressor Valves
title:91bc4ab11064bae5.abstract: The so-called stiction effect (or stiction force) is one of the sources of thermodynamic losses in compressor suction and discharge systems. The losses associated with the stiction effect are caused by a deformation of the lubricating oil film between the valve and the seat. This generates a delay in the valve opening, since larger pressure differencesbetween the cylinder and the discharge and/or suction chambers are needed to compensate for those effects. This paper advances a theoretical model for solving the dynamic behavior of a ring-shaped lubricant oil film between a discharge valve and the seat. The valve is allowed to move under the action of an external force due to the timedependent pressure difference between the cylinder and the discharge chamber. The main contributions of the model are the consideration of a finite amount of oil between the valve and the seat and mathematical relationships for calculating the initial condition for the oil film thickness. The model results are compared with those obtained with the Khalifa and Liu (1998) method. At conditions typical of discharge systems of domestic refrigeration compressors, viscous effects are the dominant component in the oil stiction force under dynamic conditions
